formula: am/is/are + past participle (present) · was/were + past participle (past) · by + agent (optional)
when_to_use: When the RESULT or the thing is more important than who did it, or the doer is unknown/obvious. Form: the correct form of 'be' + past participle. Add 'by + agent' only when the doer matters.
when_to_use_ar: عندما تكون النتيجة أو الشيء أهم من الفاعل، أو الفاعل غير معروف/واضح. الصيغة: الشكل الصحيح من be + التصريف الثالث. أضف 'by + الفاعل' فقط إذا كان مهمًا.
why_arabic_speakers_struggle: Arabic forms the passive by changing vowels inside the verb (كُتِبَ) with no auxiliary, so learners drop 'be' ('The house built in 1990') or use the past simple instead of the participle ('was wrote', 'was builded').

examples.en: These shoes are made in Italy.
This song was written by my friend.

common_errors.explanation: The passive needs the 'be' auxiliary before the participle.

common_errors.wrong: This song was wrote by my friend.
common_errors.correct: This song was written by my friend.
common_errors.explanation: Use the past participle (written), not the past simple (wrote).
'build' is irregular — the participle is 'built', not 'builded'.

practice_fill_blank.sentence: The pyramids ___ (build) thousands of years ago.

quick_rule: be + past participle. Present: am/is/are. Past: was/were. 'by + agent' only if the doer matters.
quick_rule_ar: be + التصريف الثالث. المضارع: am/is/are. الماضي: was/were. 'by + الفاعل' فقط إذا كان مهمًا.
mnemonic: No 'be', no passive. Third form, not second: written not wrote.
connect_to_speaking: In accent week 12 you practised weak 'be' + stressed participle and weak 'by'. Say: 'the bridge wəz BUILT in 1990' and 'painted baɪ PiCASSo' — light auxiliary, strong participle and agent.
